blocks.text: The this keyword refers to an object.

In JavaScript, this is used to access
the object that is calling a method.
When used inside an object method, this refers to the object.

blocks.caption: Example

items: this.firstName refers to the firstName property of the person object
this.lastName refers to the lastName property of the person object

blocks.text: The this keyword makes it possible to use the same method with different objects.

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: When used alone, this refers to the global object.
In a browser, the global object is the window object.
In strict mode, this is undefined when used alone.
In a regular function, this also refers to the global object.

blocks.caption: Example

items: In an object method, this refers to the object
this lets methods access object properties
Used alone, this refers to the global object
